{{Short description|Football results}}
The '''2024 Copa Libertadores qualifying stages''' were played from 6 February to 14 March 2024.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://cdn.conmebol.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/11/Calendario-2024_aprobado-Consejo-10-07-2023-1.pdf|title=CALENDÁRIO 2024: CONMEBOL Libertadores - CONMEBOL Sudamericana - RECOPA|publisher=CONMEBOL.com|date=10 July 2023|access-date=30 November 2023}}</ref> A total of 19 teams competed in the qualifying stages to decide four of the 32 places in the [[2024 Copa Libertadores group stage|group stage]] of the [[2024 Copa Libertadores]].<ref name="regulations">{{cite web|url=https://cdn.conmebol.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/12/Manual-de-Clubes-CL-2024-ESP-Digital.pdf|title=Manual de Clubes CONMEBOL Libertadores 2024|publisher=CONMEBOL|date=13 December 2023|access-date=18 December 2023}}</ref>

==Draw==
<section begin=Draw />
The draw for the qualifying stages was held on 19 December 2023, 12:00 [[Time in Paraguay|PYST]] ([[UTC−03:00|UTC−3]]), at the CONMEBOL Convention Centre in [[Luque]], [[Paraguay]].<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.directvsports.com/futbol/Cuando-es-el-sorteo-de-la-Copa-CONMEBOL-Libertadores-2024-y-la-Copa-CONMEBOL-Sudamericana-2024-20231212-0007.html|title=Cuándo es el sorteo de la Copa CONMEBOL Libertadores 2024 y la Copa CONMEBOL Sudamericana 2024|trans-title=When is the draw for the 2024 Copa CONMEBOL Libertadores and Copa CONMEBOL Sudamericana|publisher=DSports|date=11 December 2023|access-date=18 December 2023|language=es}}</ref><ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.conmebol.com/noticias/los-cruces-de-la-fase-preliminar-en-la-conmebol-libertadores-2024/|title=Los cruces de la Fase Preliminar en la CONMEBOL Libertadores 2024|trans-title=The Preliminary Stage matchups in the 2024 CONMEBOL Libertadores|publisher=CONMEBOL|date=19 December 2023|access-date=20 December 2023|language=es}}</ref>

Teams were seeded by their ''CONMEBOL Clubs ranking'' as of 18 December 2023 (shown in parentheses),<ref name="ranking">{{cite web|url=https://cdn.conmebol.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/12/Ranking-CONMEBOL-2024-Final-1.pdf|title=Ranking de Clubes de la CONMEBOL 2024|trans-title=2024 CONMEBOL Clubs Ranking|publisher=CONMEBOL|date=18 December 2023|access-date=18 December 2023|language=es}}</ref> taking into account the following three factors:<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.conmebol.com/sites/default/files/sistema_de_puntaje_ranking_de_clubes_2021.pdf|title=RANKING DE CLUBES DE LA CONMEBOL 2021 SISTEMA DE PUNTAJE|publisher=CONMEBOL|date=2 February 2021|language=es|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20210830090237/https://www.conmebol.com/sites/default/files/sistema_de_puntaje_ranking_de_clubes_2021.pdf|archive-date=30 August 2021}}</ref>
#Performance in the last 10 years, taking into account Copa Libertadores and Copa Sudamericana results in the period 2014–2023.
#Historical coefficient, taking into account Copa Libertadores and Copa Sudamericana results in the period 1960–2013 and 2002–2013 respectively.
#Local tournament champion, with bonus points awarded to domestic league champions of the last 10 years.

For the first stage, the six teams were drawn into three ties (E1–E3), with the teams from Pot 1 hosting the second leg.<ref name="draw procedure">{{cite web|url=https://www.conmebol.com/noticias/pautas-de-sorteo-para-la-conmebol-libertadores-y-sudamericana-2024/|title=Pautas de sorteo para la CONMEBOL Libertadores y Sudamericana 2024|trans-title=Draw guidelines for the 2024 CONMEBOL Libertadores and Sudamericana|publisher=CONMEBOL|date=12 December 2023|access-date=18 December 2023|language=es}}</ref>

For the second stage, the 16 teams were drawn into eight ties (C1–C8), with the teams from Pot 1 hosting the second leg. Teams from the same association could not be drawn into the same tie, excluding the three winners of the first stage, which were seeded in Pot 2 and whose identity was not known at the time of the draw, and could be drawn into the same tie with another team from the same association.<ref name="draw procedure"/>

For the third stage, the eight winners of the second stage were allocated without any draw into the following four ties (G1–G4), with the team in each tie with the higher CONMEBOL ranking hosting the second leg.<ref name="draw procedure"/>

*Second stage winner C1 vs. Second stage winner C8
*Second stage winner C2 vs. Second stage winner C7
*Second stage winner C3 vs. Second stage winner C6
*Second stage winner C4 vs. Second stage winner C5<section end=Draw />

==Format==
<section begin=Format />
In the qualifying stages, each tie was played on a home-and-away [[two-legged tie|two-legged]] basis. If tied on aggregate, [[Overtime (sports)#Association football|extra time]] would not be played, and a [[Penalty shoot-out (association football)|penalty shoot-out]] would be used to determine the winner (Regulations Article 2.4.3).<ref name="regulations"/><section end=Format />

==Bracket==
<section begin=Bracket />
The qualifying stages are structured as follows:
*'''First stage (6 teams):''' The three winners of the first stage advance to the second stage to join the 13 teams which are given byes to the second stage.
*'''Second stage (16 teams):''' The eight winners of the second stage advance to the third stage.
*'''Third stage (8 teams):''' The four winners of the third stage advance to the group stage to join the 28 direct entrants. The four teams eliminated in the third stage enter the Copa Sudamericana group stage.<section end=Bracket />
The bracket was decided based on the first stage draw and second stage draw, which was held on 19 December 2023.

==Third stage==
